verdict.rationale: Programmatic access to audiences, automations and campaign results is a fair question for an email marketing platform, but the evidence pack never documents a Moosend API, data-export endpoint, or agent-facing interface. The only related items are adjacent: in-app KPI dashboards and no-code app integrations, which give an agent no direct way to pull and report on the email program.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my whole email program — audiences, live automations, recent campaign results — programmatically and report on what's working
